steps.objective: 完成「OpenZFS：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for OpenZFS: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付三種範圍、聯集演算、重疊反例與重建/驗證兩條進度線，註明適用的重建工作流。
在交接件中加入「OpenZFS：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：手合併 [0,30) 與 [20,40) 得 40 而非 50；加入 [40,100) 後才得完整 100 GiB；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：分開 copied_ranges、verified_ranges 與 failed_ranges，將半開區間做聯集；進度報表不可使用單一 completed 欄位。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver all three range types, union calculations, overlap cases and separate reconstruction and verification progress lines. Identify the workflow being modeled rather than generalizing one sequence to every pool layout.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for OpenZFS: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Independently merge [0,30) and [20,40) to obtain 40 rather than 50 GiB. Only after adding [40,100) does the union cover the full 100 GiB target. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Keep copied, verified and failed ranges separately and union half-open intervals. Avoid one ambiguous completed field; the report must state which operation completed for which part of the target. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
